rows.label: Italy
rows.hook: is a peninsula nation of pasta, pizza, Rome and Venice, jutting into the Mediterranean

rows.label: Moon

rows.label: Jupiter
rows.description: fifth planet in the Solar System and largest among all; gaseous giant mainly composed of hydrogen and helium

rows.label: Kaaba
rows.description: cubical shrine in Mecca, Saudi Arabia; direction of prayer for Muslims
rows.hook: is the stone building Muslims face when they pray, at the heart of the Great Mosque of Mecca

rows.label: Pantheon
rows.description: ancient Roman temple in Rome, Italy
rows.hook: is an ancient Roman temple, now a church, famous for its huge concrete roof with an open oculus

rows.label: Andromeda Galaxy
rows.description: barred spiral galaxy within the Local Group

rows.label: Banana
rows.description: elongated, edible fruit produced by several kinds of large herbaceous flowering plants in the genus Musa
rows.hook: is a long yellow fruit that grows in bunches and is peeled before eating

rows.label: Mount Fuji
rows.description: volcano in Yamanashi and Shizuoka Prefectures, Japan
rows.hook: is the highest mountain in Japan, an active volcano famous for its snowcapped peak

rows.label: Tornado
rows.description: violently rotating column of air that is in contact with both the earth's surface and a cumulonimbus cloud in the air
rows.hook: is a violently rotating column of air from a storm cloud, feared across the American Midwest

rows.label: Lemon
rows.hook: is a sour yellow citrus fruit used for juice, as in lemonade

rows.label: Hurricane
rows.description: rapidly rotating storm system that forms in the tropics
rows.hook: is a powerful tropical storm of the Atlantic with strong winds, heavy rain and an eye at its center

rows.label: Croissant
rows.hook: is a buttery, flaky laminated-dough pastry, a classic French breakfast

rows.label: Pancake
rows.description: a brown thin, round cake made of eggs, milk and flour
rows.hook: is a flat griddled batter cake, stacked and served with syrup for breakfast

rows.label: Pearl
rows.description: hard object produced within the soft tissue of a living shelled mollusc
rows.hook: is a lustrous gem formed inside an oyster or other mollusk

rows.label: Doritos

rows.label: Cinnamon roll

rows.label: Dartboard
rows.hook: is the target that players throw small pointed missiles at, with a bullseye at the center
